profile.brief: Coach profile per DESIGN.md §8.4 and design/reference/profile.html (match it closely). Data: getProfile, getTree, getRelated in web/src/lib/queries/people.ts (read them; person.bioExcerpt is a short verbatim quote from the source bio, person.about is coach-written and usually null). Breadcrumb (program > Staff > name). Header card: Avatar, name, Unclaimed or Demo badge, current title at program (link to /programs/[slug]), location/state, level + conference badges, stat group (seasons coached, coaching stops, in coaching tree -> /in/[slug]/tree, first season), actions Connect (server action creating a pending row in connections when signed in as the demo coach; otherwise a sign-in prompt using the demo switcher), Message (-> /messaging), More menu (Copy link, Report an error). Unclaimed banner: built from public sources with SourceLink(s) to the staff bio URL(s), 'Is this you? Claim profile' -> /claim/[slug]. About: person.about if present, else the bioExcerpt as a quote with attribution 'Quoted from the staff bio · <domain>' and a line that the coach can replace it after claiming; omit the section entirely if neither exists. Experience: SeasonStrip + grouped roles per program (role progression, season ranges right-aligned with tabular numerals, inferred years dotted underline when yearsExplicit is false, a 'Source' disclosure revealing the evidence quote and link), 'Dates not listed' handled gracefully, legend. Playing career. Coaching tree preview (Worked under / Worked alongside / Coached under <first name>) with Explore tree link; hide groups that are empty and show a quiet empty state if the whole tree is empty. Education from almaMater (show only what is known). Right rail: Current program card (staff count on the network, open jobs, View staff, athletics site), Same tree, People also viewed (head coaches in the same conference, excluding the person). generateMetadata + JSON-LD Person (name, jobTitle, worksFor). notFound() for unknown slugs. Put extra queries in web/src/lib/queries/profile.ts and actions in web/src/lib/actions/profile.ts.

tree.brief: Coaching tree explorer per DESIGN.md §8.8. Focal coach in the center; people they worked under above; people who worked under them below; people they worked alongside to the sides (or a separate band). Server-rendered SVG node-link diagram with a clean layered layout (no physics libraries), nodes are links to /in/[slug] and each node offers its own tree link; edge labels or tooltips show the program and seasons. Include an optional second level (mentors of mentors, mentees of mentees) toggled by ?depth=2. Legend, counts, breadcrumb back to the profile. Phone (390px): replace the diagram with stacked grouped lists. Handle empty trees honestly ('No overlapping staff seasons found yet' with an explanation of how trees are derived). Queries in web/src/lib/queries/tree.ts (build on getTree in people.ts). generateMetadata.

landing.brief: Signed-out landing per DESIGN.md §8.10. If a demo session exists, redirect to /feed. Hero: one-line value prop from BRAND, a large search field (people + programs; submits to /search?q=), and two CTAs: 'Find your profile' (-> /search) and 'Try the demo' (a form posting to the switchDemoAccount server action with role coach). Proof points with REAL numbers from getDatasetStats (programs, coaches, coaching stints, tree connections) and a one-line note on where the data comes from (public athletics staff pages). A row of 3-6 sample coach profile cards: real head coaches with rich careers (query: people with many tenures), linking to their profiles. A short 'How it works' section (built from public sources -> coaches claim and correct -> programs hire) and an employer section (post jobs, search by coaching tree). Calm, LinkedIn-logged-out-homepage quality; no stock imagery, no gradients. Footer. Queries in web/src/lib/queries/landing.ts.

feed.brief: Home feed per DESIGN.md §8.5 and design/reference/feed.html (match it closely). Left rail: mini-profile for the session person (demo coach) with profile viewers/search appearances marked as demo data, Open to opportunities row (-> /settings/availability), shortcuts (My coaching tree, Saved jobs). If signed out, show a compact card inviting the viewer to try the demo (switchDemoAccount form) and still render the public feed. Center: filter tabs (All / Moves / Jobs via ?filter=), move cards from getMoves (lib/queries/feed.ts) with the 'why you're seeing this' strip when relevant (same program/conference as the viewer), a short career record (last 2-3 stints with years) from tenures, source link to the staff bio domain, demo actions (Congratulate toggles client-side with a count; Message -> /messaging; Share copies the profile link). Job cards from getRecentJobs with 'Sample listing' label. A 'More staff moves' digest for the long tail with a Show more link (pagination via ?page=). Right rail: Carousel tracker (getCarouselStats: hires, promotions, open jobs marked Sample, conference table with the viewer's conference highlighted) and People you may know (getRelated for the session person, fallback: coaches in the viewer's conference). Queries in web/src/lib/queries/feedx.ts; client components in web/src/components/feed/.

program.brief: Program page per DESIGN.md §8.6. Works for ANY organization slug: registry programs (inRegistry true; NCAA D-III football programs) get the full page; other orgs (other colleges, high schools, pro teams that appear in careers) get a lighter page listing the coaches who worked there. Header card: OrgMark, full name, nickname, level badge, conference badge, state, athletics site link (external), counts (staff on the network, alumni coaches, open jobs). Tabs via ?tab=staff|alumni|jobs: Staff grouped by unit (getStaff in lib/queries/orgs.ts), Alumni coaches with their past role and seasons at the program and where they are now (getAlumni), Jobs (getOrgJobs; Sample listing labels). Registry programs with no staff data (we could not read about 48 staff pages; the site blocked automated access or was unreachable) must show an honest empty state linking to their athletics site. Right rail: conference peers (other programs in the same conference with staff counts) and a 'Hiring?' card for employers. generateMetadata + JSON-LD SportsTeam/CollegeOrUniversity. notFound() for unknown slugs. Extra queries in web/src/lib/queries/program.ts.

search.brief: Search per DESIGN.md §8.7. Query params: q, type=people|programs, division, conference, state, role (role group), workedAt (org slug), workedUnder (person slug), page. People results via searchPeople (lib/queries/search.ts), programs via searchOrgs. Left (desktop) facet panel: role group, conference, state, division, 'Worked at' (program picker with typeahead to /api/typeahead or a select of registry programs), 'Worked under' (coach picker). Facets are links/forms that update the URL (works without JS). Phone: a 'Filters' button opening a full-height sheet (details/summary or a client dialog) and an applied-filters chip row. Result rows: PersonRow with current role, program + conference badges, and one line of tree context when filtering by workedAt/workedUnder; programs tab shows program rows with staff counts. Result count, pagination, empty state with suggestions, and a no-query state with popular searches (e.g. head coaches in the USA South). generateMetadata. Extra queries in web/src/lib/queries/searchx.ts.

jobs.brief: Jobs per DESIGN.md §8.9 and §8.13. /jobs: list/detail split on desktop (list left, selected job right, ?id=), list only on phone; filters (role group, state, conference, keyword) via URL; every sample job shows a 'Sample listing' label. /jobs/[id]: full job page with org card (link to program page), salary range, employment type, posted time, description rendered from markdown-ish text (bold + bullets; no dangerous HTML), Apply button (demo: opens a confirmation stating applications are disabled in the demo), Save job (client state), and 'People from this program on the network' (staff of the org). /employers/jobs/new: requires the employer demo session (otherwise explain and offer the switcher); form (title, role group, unit, employment type, salary min/max, description) with live preview card, validation (zod), server action that inserts the job with isDemo true and source 'native' for the employer's org, then redirects to the new job page; a stubbed checkout step that clearly says payments are disabled in the demo. Queries in web/src/lib/queries/jobsx.ts, actions in web/src/lib/actions/jobs.ts.

claim.brief: Claim flow per DESIGN.md §8.11 and Open to opportunities settings per §8.12. /claim/[slug]: 3-step flow (1 confirm identity: school email field with a stubbed 6-digit code step; 2 review your career: every stint listed with Correct / Needs a fix toggles and an inline correction note; 3 publish) with a progress indicator. Must NOT modify the real person's records: the final step inserts a row into claims (status 'verified') and shows a clear message that in the live product this publishes the profile, while the demo changes nothing on the public page. Unknown slug -> notFound. /settings/availability: requires the demo coach session (else explain + switcher); form bound to the availability table: open toggle, audience (search firms / selected programs / all employers except my current program), selected programs picker (registry programs), roles wanted, regions; strong privacy explanation (never shown on the public profile; current program excluded); save via server action with success state. Queries in web/src/lib/queries/claim.ts, actions in web/src/lib/actions/claim.ts and availability.ts.

employer.brief: Hiring pipeline per DESIGN.md §8.14. Requires the employer demo session (else explain and offer the switcher). Board with columns Sourced / Contacted / Interview / Offer for the AD's shortlist (shortlists + shortlistEntries tables, seeded with 9 candidates), candidate cards (avatar, name, current role/program, tree context such as who they worked under, note), move between stages via server actions (buttons/menu; no drag-and-drop library needed), add/edit a note, remove from pipeline. Phone: columns become a segmented control showing one stage at a time. Also build a reusable web/src/components/employer/AddToPipelineButton.tsx (props: personId) + server action so the integration pass can place it on profiles and search results for employer sessions. Header with the search name and counts, and a 'Find candidates' link to /search with useful presets (e.g. role=coordinator). Queries in web/src/lib/queries/employer.ts, actions in web/src/lib/actions/employer.ts.

messaging.brief: Messaging per DESIGN.md §8.15 and notifications per §8.16. Requires a demo session (else explain + switcher). Messages need demo threads: you MAY edit web/scripts/seed.ts ONLY to add a clearly delimited '// demo messages' block that inserts a few additional fictional demo users (isDemo true, names clearly fictional) and 3-4 short, realistic demo threads with the demo coach (e.g. an AD reaching out about a coordinator opening, a former colleague); then run `cd web && npm run db:seed`. /messaging: inbox list + thread view (desktop split; phone list -> thread with ?thread=), composer that sends via server action (inserts into messages), unread state, empty state, every thread marked Demo. /notifications: list from the notifications table for the session user, grouped Today/Earlier, mark-all-read action, empty state. Queries in web/src/lib/queries/messaging.ts, actions in web/src/lib/actions/messaging.ts.
